title: Held-out acceptance for: Pre-orders for a small bakery

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Orders for a day close at a cut-off the day before (the baker needs time to bake), and the page says so.
On the final build, show that: An item that has sold out for that day cannot be ordered any more.
On the final build, show that: The customer is told clearly that the order went through, with what they ordered and the collection time.
On the final build, show that: The baker's daily list adds up quantities per item, not just a list of orders.
On the final build, show that: A phone number that is obviously wrong is caught before the order is taken.
On the final build, show that: Nobody pays online; the page must not ask for card details.

title: Held-out acceptance for: A volunteer rota for a food bank

checks.check: On the final build, show that: A shift has a maximum number of volunteers and cannot be over-filled.
On the final build, show that: A volunteer cannot be booked on two shifts at the same time.
On the final build, show that: Volunteers can cancel, and the freed place becomes available again.
On the final build, show that: The coordinator is warned about shifts that are short of people close to the day.
On the final build, show that: Volunteers only see first names of others, not phone numbers.

title: Held-out acceptance for: A reading log for a primary class

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Children's full names and details are not visible to other children.
On the final build, show that: Page counts that are impossible (negative, or thousands in a day) are refused or flagged.
On the final build, show that: The teacher's view highlights children who have logged nothing for a while.
On the final build, show that: Entering a log is simple enough for an eight-year-old: few fields, forgiving input.
On the final build, show that: Data from last school year can be archived without deleting it.

title: Held-out acceptance for: A donor list and thank-you letters for a charity

checks.check: On the final build, show that: A donor who asked not to be contacted never gets a letter.
On the final build, show that: Amounts are stored exactly (no rounding errors) and totals per year add up to the donations.
On the final build, show that: The same person giving twice is recognised as one donor, not two.
On the final build, show that: Letters can be printed or emailed, and it is recorded which was sent.
On the final build, show that: Personal data can be exported or removed for a donor who asks.

title: Held-out acceptance for: Expense approvals for a team

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Someone cannot approve their own expense.
On the final build, show that: A rejected expense can be corrected and resubmitted, keeping its history.
On the final build, show that: Amounts carry a currency, and the monthly export does not mix currencies silently.
On the final build, show that: Every approval and rejection is recorded with who did it and when.
On the final build, show that: An expense already exported cannot be edited afterwards.

title: Held-out acceptance for: An internal status page

checks.check: On the final build, show that: A service that has not reported for a while is shown as unknown, not as up.
On the final build, show that: A single failed check does not flip a service to down; a few in a row do.
On the final build, show that: Times are shown in the viewer's time zone, not the server's.
On the final build, show that: The page itself keeps working when one of the services it checks is slow.
On the final build, show that: History is kept for a bounded period and does not grow forever.

title: Held-out acceptance for: A command-line tool to rename photos by date

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Two photos taken in the same second do not overwrite each other.
On the final build, show that: Nothing is renamed without a way to preview what would happen first.
On the final build, show that: Photos without a date in their metadata are left alone and reported.
On the final build, show that: Running it twice does not rename already-renamed photos again.
On the final build, show that: It never deletes a file.

title: Held-out acceptance for: Feature flags for our web app

checks.check: On the final build, show that: The same user keeps seeing the same side of a percentage rollout across visits.
On the final build, show that: If the flag service is unreachable, the app falls back to a safe default instead of failing.
On the final build, show that: Changing a flag is recorded with who changed it.
On the final build, show that: A flag can be turned off instantly for everyone as a kill switch.
On the final build, show that: Unknown flag names are reported rather than silently treated as on.

title: Held-out acceptance for: Forward webhooks to our team chat

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Webhooks with a bad signature are ignored, not posted.
On the final build, show that: The same webhook delivered twice produces one message.
On the final build, show that: Customer card numbers or full emails never appear in the chat message.
On the final build, show that: If the chat service is down, messages are retried later rather than lost.
On the final build, show that: Only the event types we care about are posted.

title: Held-out acceptance for: A notes app that works offline

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Notes written offline are not lost when the app closes.
On the final build, show that: Search finds words inside notes, not just titles, and is fast with thousands of notes.
On the final build, show that: Editing the same note on two devices does not silently drop one version.
On the final build, show that: Deleted notes can be recovered for a while.
On the final build, show that: Notes can be exported as plain markdown files.

title: Held-out acceptance for: Appointment reminders for a physiotherapy clinic

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Reminders are sent at a sensible local time, not in the middle of the night.
On the final build, show that: A patient who has opted out never receives a reminder.
On the final build, show that: A cancellation by reply frees the slot and tells the clinic.
On the final build, show that: Reminder texts do not include medical details.
On the final build, show that: An appointment moved after the reminder was sent gets a corrected reminder.

title: Held-out acceptance for: Invoices for a freelance illustrator

checks.check: On the final build, show that: Invoice numbers are sequential and never reused, even if an invoice is cancelled.
On the final build, show that: Totals, tax and discounts add up exactly on the invoice.
On the final build, show that: Once sent, an invoice is not edited; a correction is a credit note or a new invoice.
On the final build, show that: Unpaid invoices past their due date are clearly marked.
On the final build, show that: The illustrator's bank details appear on the invoice exactly as entered.
